coach_speak_incremental_accuracy_2013_20.classification_evidence: Interval sits entirely above zero but the magnitude is a fifth of one accuracy point on a player-level call, and the paired log-loss read on the identical cross-fit is a coin flip (P+ 0.41); no admissible closing-ground applies (no whole-interval wrong sign, no positive-control bound on this comparison), so this stays unresolved_below_power per AGENTS.md rather than being over-read as a resolved finding.
coach_speak_incremental_accuracy_2013_20.description: Does a predeclared coach-speak phrase (game-time decision/questionable/doubtful/hopeful/day-to-day/trending/expected-to-play/will-not-play/ruled-out) in a PFT headline add accuracy beyond that week's own official injury report_status at predicting next-game inactive status? Cross-fit odd/even kickoff-month, report_status-only baseline vs report_status+phrase_category candidate, 0.5-threshold accuracy read, 2013-2024 skill-position REG population, 11718 player-weeks.
coach_speak_incremental_accuracy_2013_20.plain_summary: Presser phrases like 'ruled out' or 'expected to play' barely move the needle once you already know the official questionable/doubtful/out tag -- a razor-thin edge, not a useful signal.

coach_speak_incremental_log_loss_2013_20.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero and leans slightly negative (P+ 0.41); this is the calibrated-probability companion to coach_speak_incremental_accuracy_2013_2024's thresholded-accuracy read on the identical cross-fit, and the two disagree, which is itself evidence the accuracy read is a marginal threshold effect rather than a real probability shift. unresolved_below_power, no admissible closing-ground.
coach_speak_incremental_log_loss_2013_20.description: Same cross-fit design as coach_speak_incremental_accuracy_2013_2024 (report_status-only baseline vs report_status+phrase_category candidate, 2013-2024 skill-position REG, 11718 player-weeks), scored as calibrated Bernoulli log loss instead of thresholded accuracy.
coach_speak_incremental_log_loss_2013_20.plain_summary: On a properly calibrated probability rather than a yes/no call, the coach-speak phrase adds essentially nothing beyond the official designation.

coach_speak_production_screen_accuracy_2.classification_evidence: Week-blocked interval crosses zero (P+ 0.43); the paired positive control on the identical 237-switch decision set resolves to +45.4 points, P+ 1.0, so the instrument clearly can detect an effect of that size and this -0.2 point read sits nowhere near that bound -- not bounded_by_control, genuinely unresolved_below_power.
coach_speak_production_screen_accuracy_2.description: Starter-weighted (prior-week trailing snap share >=0.5, asof-joined independent of this-week's outcome) expected-absence fade built from phrase-fired player-weeks, stacked on the active model's opener pick, week-blocked bootstrap against the served opener evaluation (model d49194e04945a5e5). Seasons 2020-2025 (2025 games carry zero signal by construction: official report_status unreadable that season), 1503 graded games, 237 flips.
coach_speak_production_screen_accuracy_2.plain_summary: Trying to turn presser-phrase reading into an actual pick-flipping rule on top of today's model did not beat just playing the model's own pick.

coach_speak_production_screen_positive_c.classification_evidence: This is the positive-control measurement itself (perfect foresight), not a hypothesis being adjudicated, so no closing-ground applies to it; recorded unresolved_below_power to match this repository's precedent for positive-control cells (docs/follow_news_gate.md's PC arms), purely so the instrument's demonstrated power is on the record beside the null it bounds.
coach_speak_production_screen_positive_c.description: Positive control for coach_speak_production_screen_accuracy_2020_2025: perfect foresight on the identical 237-game switch decision set, same week-blocked bootstrap, same 1503-game population.
coach_speak_production_screen_positive_c.plain_summary: If you could somehow know in advance exactly who would sit out, that alone would be worth roughly 45 accuracy points on this slice -- which is the yardstick the -0.2 point screen result above is measured against.
